Package model.dungeon

Class Layouts

java.lang.Object
model.dungeon.Layouts
public class Layouts extends Object
A library to hold preset layouts for Floor maps.

Each layout is an array of Strings where each character represents a Tile. Each character represents:

  • S - Spawn
  • E - Exit
  • * - Border
  • v - Wall
  • x - Spike
  • w - Water
  • h - Heat
  • b - Bat
  • T - Treasure
  • . - Empty Tile
